Step 3: Modify ONLY the "About Me" Card
Replace the "About Me" card structure with this:

<div class="tour-card tour-card-about-me">
  <div class="card-inner">
    <div class="card-front">
      <!-- Static image (default state) -->
      <img src="assets/hp/AboutMe.webp" alt="About Me" class="card-static-img">
      
      <!-- Hover video (hidden by default) -->
      <video autoplay loop muted playsinline class="card-hover-video">
        <source src="assets/hp/luis_hover.webm" type="video/webm">
        <source src="assets/hp/luis_hover.mp4" type="video/mp4">
      </video>
      
      <div class="card-overlay"></div>
      <div class="card-icon">
        <!-- Keep your existing icon SVG here -->
      </div>
      <h3>About Me</h3>
    </div>
    <div class="card-back card-back-coral">
      <!-- Keep your existing back side content here -->
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
Key Changes:

Added .tour-card-about-me class for specific targeting
Static image now has .card-static-img class
Added <video> element with .card-hover-video class
Both video formats included for cross-browser compatibility
Step 4: Add CSS for the Card Hover Video
In your <style> section, add this CSS after your existing card styles (around where you have .card-front img styles):

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HOVER VIDEO ANIMATION FOR "ABOUT ME" CARD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Video element in card front */
.card-hover-video {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Static image stays at z-index 1 by default */
.card-static-img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  z-index: 2;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out;
}

/* Card overlay, icon, and title stay on top */
.card-overlay {
  z-index: 3;
}

.card-icon {
  z-index: 4;
}

.card-front h3 {
  z-index: 4;
}

/* Show video on hover, hide static image */
.tour-card-about-me:hover .card-hover-video {
  opacity: 1;
  z-index: 2;
}

.tour-card-about-me:hover .card-static-img {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Optional: Subtle scale on hover */
.tour-card-about-me:hover .card-hover-video {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out, transform 0.5s ease-in-out;
}

Step 6: Test It
Open index-videotest.html in your browser
Scroll down to "The human & the professional" section
Hover over the "About Me" card (NOT the hero tiles)
Video should fade in smoothly over the static image
When you move away, it fades back to the static image


🎯 Important Notes:
DO NOT touch the hero tiles at the top—those stay as-is with images only
ONLY the "About Me" card in the 2x2 grid gets the video treatment
The other three cards (Timeline, Resume, Brand Guidelines) remain unchanged
The card flip animation on click still works—the video is only for the front side hover state


🔧 Optional: Control Video Playback on Hover
If you want the video to only play when hovering (saves bandwidth), add this JavaScript before your closing </body> tag:

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const aboutMeCard = document.querySelector('.tour-card-about-me');
  
  if (aboutMeCard) {
    const video = aboutMeCard.querySelector('.card-hover-video');
    
    if (video) {
      // Pause video initially
      video.pause();
      
      // Play on hover
      aboutMeCard.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        video.play();
      });
      
      // Pause and reset when hover ends
      aboutMeCard.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        video.pause();
        video.currentTime = 0;
      });
    }
  }
});
</script>
